SHALLOW.logic: The doorway fan's wind pushes light targets out of its lane.

MEDIUM.name: Take a Number
MEDIUM.description: The breeze keeps the queue at a distance while the attendant quietly patches an old mistake.
MEDIUM.logic: The fan pushes approaching targets away while the first-aid modifier closes wounds on the user behind it.

DEEP.name: Outpatient Express
DEEP.description: The fan sends bandages and patients toward the exit, then leaves the last clean gauze for its operator.
DEEP.logic: The fan's loose-junk lane carries the kit's gauze downrange, patching the recipient while pushing them out of the doorway. After the gust, reserved supplies close the operator's own wounds.

SHALLOW.name: Portable Window
SHALLOW.description: The clear panel does exactly what a wall should, provided you keep holding it up.
SHALLOW.logic: The riot shield turns incoming thrown or swung objects away from its wielder.

MEDIUM.name: Unwelcome Attachment
MEDIUM.description: A blocked swing discovers that the clear wall has acquired a very small front porch spike.
MEDIUM.logic: The shield stops an incoming swing and braces the screwdriver so the same contact drives its steel point into the attacker.

DEEP.name: The Courtesy Inspection
DEEP.description: The visitor supplies the shove; your clear wall returns their machinery with a tool still inside it.
DEEP.logic: The shield braces the user while an incoming strike supplies force against the screwdriver's sheet-metal point. Penetration seats the spike in a moving part, jamming the attacker's mechanism.

combo_id: d:.30-06 hunting rifle|dmg:.30-06 rounds|u:industrial fan|m:riot shield

SHALLOW.name: Correct Box Finally
SHALLOW.description: For once the ammunition fits the rifle, and everything else can wait its turn.
SHALLOW.logic: The matching .30-06 rounds feed the hunting rifle for a deliberate ordinary shot.

MEDIUM.name: Window Seat
MEDIUM.description: The hunter gets a clear wall to work behind and a perfectly ordinary view downrange.
MEDIUM.logic: The riot shield protects the shooter while matching ammunition enables the rifle's accurate damaging shot.

DEEP.name: Between the Bolts
DEEP.description: A clear firing booth makes one deliberate point, then the doorway breeze negotiates time for the next.
DEEP.logic: The matching rounds feed a deliberate shot from behind the shield, with the dense box as ballast. During the bolt-action pause afterward, the fan pushes approaching light targets back to preserve reloading space.

combo_id: d:jug of bleach|dmg:tub of pool chlorine|u:crate of overripe produce|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Spotless Disaster
SHALLOW.description: The jug ruins a patch of clothing and a portion of the person inside it.
SHALLOW.logic: Bleach damages skin directly wherever the thrown jug splashes it.

MEDIUM.name: Fruit Whitening Service
MEDIUM.description: A burst of overripe fruit glues an unwelcome cleaning treatment to its customer.
MEDIUM.logic: The produce bursts into clinging pulp that slows the recipient and keeps skin-damaging bleach on the contacted area.

DEEP.name: The Stain Remembers
DEEP.description: The fruit makes a sticky first impression, and the chalky little grains take their time making the second.
DEEP.logic: Burst pulp traps the recipient in a clinging mess while chlorine dust stings eyes and throats. Keeping bleach and granules against skin gives their slower damaging contact time to accumulate.

SHALLOW.name: Pocket Density
SHALLOW.description: The little tin feels heavier than advertised when it introduces itself to somebody's shin.
SHALLOW.logic: The dense steel spheres make the thrown tin hit like a weight.

MEDIUM.name: Express Package
MEDIUM.description: The parcel hurts a little, then makes its recipient unexpectedly enthusiastic about getting somewhere else.
MEDIUM.logic: The heavy tin hits the recipient while the adrenaline payload injects them with a temporary movement rush.

DEEP.name: Hurry Into Tomorrow
DEEP.description: The dose tells your legs to hurry, the scattered steel questions their judgment, and tomorrow's pain arrives early.
DEEP.logic: The spring-loaded adrenaline payload speeds its recipient before the tin spills bearings underfoot. Their rushing steps lose traction, and the dose's deferred pain arrives when the rush ends.

SHALLOW.name: Today's Special
SHALLOW.description: The cooler advertises its contents with a smell that needs no chalkboard or waiter.
SHALLOW.logic: The turning steaks' far-carrying smell lures hungry targets toward the placed cooler.

MEDIUM.name: No Reservations
MEDIUM.description: Dinner calls the guests close enough for the washing station to turn them away.
MEDIUM.logic: The steaks attract visitors to the cooler, where the pressure washer's hard jet pushes them back.

DEEP.name: The Self-Cleaning Buffet
DEEP.description: The buffet gathers a queue, washes it forcefully away, and leaves the floor wearing the leftovers.
DEEP.logic: The steaks gather hungry targets for the washer's cutting, pushing jet. Its intake carries their slick fat into the spray, leaving the approached floor greasy even after the initial wash ends.

SHALLOW.name: Contractor's Greeting
SHALLOW.description: The shotgun makes a broad introduction while the power tools wait to discuss the details.
SHALLOW.logic: The pump shotgun's normal short-range spread provides the obvious damaging contact.

MEDIUM.name: Rough Opening
MEDIUM.description: The drill makes the entry and the shotgun is very rude about what comes through it.
MEDIUM.logic: The fresh drill bit chews through thin steel at close contact, giving the shotgun's damaging burst a path through the surface.

DEEP.name: Three Estimates Later
DEEP.description: The opening gets drilled, the saw commits to the job, and the operator discovers the wrist clause in the contract.
DEEP.logic: The drill opens the surface and the chainsaw pulls itself into the cut, exposing the target to a wide shotgun burst. If the driven bit binds, its wrenching torque also interrupts the operator.

SHALLOW.name: Appointment Window
SHALLOW.description: The paddles deliver a brief appointment during which your muscles accept no other bookings.
SHALLOW.logic: The defibrillator's stored discharge clenches muscles at contact, independently of the attached drill.

MEDIUM.name: Open Wide
MEDIUM.description: A jolt keeps the patient steady while a fresh bit demonstrates terrible professional judgment.
MEDIUM.logic: The paddle discharge locks the recipient's muscles while the drill bit chews into the held contact.

DEEP.name: Internal Affairs
DEEP.description: The bit gets past the casing before the charge arrives, with one unpleasant twist reserved for the operator.
DEEP.logic: The drill penetrates the casing before the defibrillator discharges through that deeper contact. The jolt locks the recipient, but a binding bit's torque wrenches the user's wrist too.

SHALLOW.name: Closed for Lunch
SHALLOW.description: The steel jaws close on schedule, and the ammunition box remains entirely off the menu.
SHALLOW.logic: The bear trap's spring jaws hold the visitor; without a matching rifle, the rounds stay inert.

MEDIUM.name: Brass Teeth
MEDIUM.description: A dense little box lends the closing jaw a weightier opinion about your ankle.
MEDIUM.logic: The ammunition box's brass-brick mass weights the trap's closing contact, making the jaw hurt as well as hold.

DEEP.name: The Other End Goes Down
DEEP.description: The brass box drops, one caught foot rises, and the steel jaws take a long time to lose interest.
DEEP.logic: The dense box serves as a falling counterweight to the spring jaw, tipping the caught foot upward. Once that lifting motion ends, the closed jaw keeps its elevated visitor held.

SHALLOW.name: Afternoon Errand
SHALLOW.description: The backpack pushes you forward while a bag of childhood mistakes rattles at your side.
SHALLOW.logic: Bracing the leaf blower lets its recoil boost the user's movement.

MEDIUM.name: Mind the Glass
MEDIUM.description: You ride the breeze away as your pursuer discovers the marbles you brought to the race.
MEDIUM.logic: Blower recoil speeds the user while its lane scatters loose marbles beneath an approaching pursuer's feet.

DEEP.name: Exit Through the Gift Shop
DEEP.description: The departing breeze leaves one machine jammed and the rest of the pursuit browsing the floor on tiptoe.
DEEP.logic: The blower propels the user and shoves a loose 9mm round into a target's track or hinge. Marbles scattered behind continue disrupting pursuit after the movement burst, without firing the ammunition.

SHALLOW.name: Warning Label Handle
SHALLOW.description: The axe hits normally despite a sack whose packaging is doing all the dramatic work.
SHALLOW.logic: The fire axe's heavy head damages on contact; fertilizer has no ignition source in this build.

MEDIUM.name: Agricultural Commitment
MEDIUM.description: A sack behind the swing makes the axe even less willing to reconsider its destination.
MEDIUM.logic: The heavy fertilizer sack adds momentum to the axe's committed swing, increasing its impact and pushing the struck target.

DEEP.name: Putting Down Roots
DEEP.description: The spike opens a place for the blade, and the heavy sack makes the new tenant difficult to evict.
DEEP.logic: The axe's back spike punches an opening before the blade bites and sticks. Fertilizer acts as ballast on the embedded haft, turning the planted axe into an anchor rather than a firework.

combo_id: d:crate of overripe produce|dmg:-|u:firefighter turnout coat|m:power drill

SHALLOW.name: Seasonal Slop
SHALLOW.description: The crate gives up on being a crate and becomes a difficult place to put your feet.
SHALLOW.logic: The overripe produce bursts on landing, leaving pulp whose gluey consistency slows movement.

MEDIUM.name: Complimentary Jacket
MEDIUM.description: The parcel delivers a sturdy coat with a complimentary lining of fruit nobody ordered.
MEDIUM.logic: The coat goes to the recipient as protective canvas, while its produce packing bursts into clinging pulp that slows them.

DEEP.name: Juice in the Works
DEEP.description: The operator wears the coat, the bit opens the casing, and the fruit insists on occupying the machinery.
DEEP.logic: The worn coat protects delivery. The drill penetrates thin casing at the landing and drives the crate through its own pulp, forcing a clinging, movement-dragging mess into the opened contact.

combo_id: d:salvaged laser cutter|dmg:airhorn|u:block of dry ice|m:propane tank

SHALLOW.name: Red Light Reception
SHALLOW.description: An impressive cutting head hosts a trumpet whose only ambition is making everybody look over.
SHALLOW.logic: The airhorn payload attracts attention to its location; this reading uses the apparatus as an announcing marker.

MEDIUM.name: The Chilly Waiting Room
MEDIUM.description: The horn calls the next visitor into a low white cloud and a distinctly uncomfortable cold spot.
MEDIUM.logic: The horn draws visitors toward the dry ice, whose contact cold freezes them at the marked location.

DEEP.name: The Floor Has Plans
DEEP.description: A screaming welcome gathers visitors in the cold while a thin hot line gives the low-lying gas ideas.
DEEP.logic: The horn gathers visitors at the cold block. The laser cuts a seam in the propane tank; its heavy cloud settles into the still-hot line and ignites after the initial cut.

combo_id: d:baseball bat|dmg:case of energy drinks|u:jug of motor oil|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Local Ball Club
SHALLOW.description: A wooden bat conducts normal business while the refreshments begin leaking into the dugout.
SHALLOW.logic: The solid wooden bat has ordinary swing weight and hurts at its sweet spot.

MEDIUM.name: Compliments of the Dugout
MEDIUM.description: The refreshment payload makes its recipient impatient on a floor that rewards careful consideration.
MEDIUM.logic: The energy drinks in the payload slot speed the recipient, while motor oil laid beneath them makes traction difficult.

DEEP.name: Seventh Inning Slurp
DEEP.description: The sweet spot sends an overcaffeinated guest across the oil, and the refreshments save their final insult for later.
DEEP.logic: The bat's springy contact sends its dosed recipient onto the oil slick, where hurried feet stumble. The drinks' delayed shakes interrupt them again after the first loss of footing passes.

SHALLOW.name: One Brief Meeting
SHALLOW.description: The paddles arrange a short meeting between all your muscles, whether they wanted one or not.
SHALLOW.logic: The defibrillator's single stored jolt clenches the contacted muscles.

MEDIUM.name: White Knuckles
MEDIUM.description: A cold paddle gives the recipient two separate reasons to stop moving for a moment.
MEDIUM.logic: Dry ice chills the paddle contact while the defibrillator discharge adds a separate muscle-clenching interruption.

DEEP.name: Please Hold the Line
DEEP.description: The axe takes a number and stays lodged while the cold and the rising whine finish your appointment.
DEEP.logic: The axe bites and sticks, holding its cold contact while the defibrillator charges. When that interval ends, the discharge clenches the recipient and prolonged dry-ice contact leaves a cold skin injury.

combo_id: d:jar of thermite|dmg:-|u:bag of marbles|m:fire extinguisher

SHALLOW.name: Grey Recess
SHALLOW.description: The powder fails to impress, but the scattered marbles still turn the floor into a childhood prank.
SHALLOW.logic: Without ignition, thermite remains grey powder; loose marbles provide the obvious stumble underfoot.

MEDIUM.name: Red Bottle Delivery
MEDIUM.description: The steel bottle makes the first point and vents a freezing explanation over the recipient.
MEDIUM.logic: The extinguisher's heavy steel body hits the target while its freezing white cone chills the contact area.

DEEP.name: Snow Day Indoors
DEEP.description: The white cloud sends you onto hidden marbles, and the floor saves its punchline until the weather clears.
DEEP.logic: The extinguisher's cold pressure cone pushes the target onto scattered marbles concealed beneath its white blanket. When the cloud clears, the rolling glass still ruins footing; the thermite never lights.

SHALLOW.name: Standard Discharge
SHALLOW.description: The paddles make their familiar point while the extra leads wait to be useful.
SHALLOW.logic: The defibrillator dumps stored charge into the contacted muscles, briefly locking them.

MEDIUM.name: Copper Handcuffs
MEDIUM.description: The clips stay attached, giving the paddles a much less cooperative patient to work with.
MEDIUM.logic: The jumper clamps bite and hold the target while carrying the defibrillator's stored jolt along their copper leads.

DEEP.name: The Unfinished Circuit
DEEP.description: The charge finishes its journey through two copper greetings, but the clips consider the conversation far from over.
DEEP.logic: Two long copper leads spread the full stored discharge between connected recipients, injuring and clenching them. After the electrical pulse ends, the clamps' mechanical bite continues holding the first contact.

combo_id: d:pump shotgun|dmg:battery boombox|u:salvaged laser cutter|m:crate of overripe produce

SHALLOW.name: Opening Track
SHALLOW.description: The shotgun carries a radio whose music is more interesting than the empty room around it.
SHALLOW.logic: The boombox in the payload slot attracts ear-led targets to the marked room rather than supplying an invented damaging sound wave.

MEDIUM.name: Sticky Dance Floor
MEDIUM.description: The music fills the room and the burst fruit makes leaving it a slow, awkward business.
MEDIUM.logic: The boombox draws listeners into produce burst by the shotgun, whose clinging pulp slows their steps.

DEEP.name: One More Song
DEEP.description: The playlist brings them in, the fruit asks them to stay, and a thin bright seam performs the closing number.
DEEP.logic: Music draws listeners into the shotgun-burst pulp, which holds their movement slow enough for the laser's patient knife-like seam to burn deeper through a steady target.

SHALLOW.name: Very Heavy Trumpet
SHALLOW.description: The hammer makes a solid point while its tiny trumpet mostly suffers from the association.
SHALLOW.logic: The sledgehammer's heavy steel head provides an ordinary damaging slam; the unfed shells do not fire.

MEDIUM.name: Call to Order
MEDIUM.description: The horn calls the room to attention just before the heavy steel chairman takes the floor.
MEDIUM.logic: The airhorn draws attention toward the marked landing while the sledgehammer supplies a committed impact.

DEEP.name: The Meeting Runs Over
DEEP.description: The steel chairman delivers a jolting verdict, then leaves the trumpet calling the next meeting from the floor.
DEEP.logic: The horn gathers a target for a steel-head slam carrying the defibrillator's muscle-clenching discharge. If the target falls, the heavy head wedges the horn button down, keeping that fallen location interesting.

SHALLOW.name: Two Breezes Please
SHALLOW.description: Two large motors agree on moving air and leave the electrical luggage out of the discussion.
SHALLOW.logic: The fan and leaf blower both push loose things with wind, creating a simple doorway shove.

MEDIUM.name: Frame of Mind
MEDIUM.description: The rolling frame gives the paddles somewhere to send their charge while the breeze makes personal space compulsory.
MEDIUM.logic: The fan pushes the visitor while the defibrillator's discharge travels through the contacted conductive frame, clenching their muscles.

DEEP.name: The Hostile Crossdraft
DEEP.description: Opposing breezes deliver you to a charged frame, and the remaining mist makes the room difficult after the motors settle.
DEEP.logic: Opposed fan and blower lanes shove a visitor toward the defibrillator-fed frame, locking muscles at contact. The battery's leaked acid rides those lanes as mist, leaving corrosive injury after the pushing interval ends.

combo_id: d:salvaged laser cutter|dmg:-|u:-|m:jug of motor oil

SHALLOW.name: Dark Lacquer
SHALLOW.description: The bright line leaves a hot mark while the black jug waits to become relevant.
SHALLOW.logic: The laser cutter scorches its contact seam before any oil needs to participate.

MEDIUM.name: Oil Painting
MEDIUM.description: The oil keeps the customer in the picture long enough for the bright brush to leave a mark.
MEDIUM.logic: Motor oil's clinging slick slows the recipient under a laser seam whose heat can ignite that flammable coating.

DEEP.name: The Frame Is Still Wet
DEEP.description: The black floor holds the pose, the thin line cuts it, and the finished work keeps smoldering after the artist moves on.
DEEP.logic: The oil sheet robs the target of traction for a steady cutting pass. The laser cuts through the held seam and heats the clinging film until it keeps burning after the beam leaves.

SHALLOW.name: Hazard Diamond Deluxe
SHALLOW.description: An axe with warning-labeled luggage still mostly solves its problems by being an axe.
SHALLOW.logic: The heavy axe head cuts on contact; fertilizer and revolverless .357 rounds do not spontaneously ignite or fire.

MEDIUM.name: Weighted Credentials
MEDIUM.description: A sack and a pocketful of cartridges lend serious authority to the little spike behind the blade.
MEDIUM.logic: The heavy fertilizer and dense .357 rounds ballast the swing, driving the axe's hole-punching back spike through the contact surface.

DEEP.name: Maintenance Has Left
DEEP.description: The weighted axe opens the casing and the screwdriver stays behind as an extremely firm out-of-office message.
DEEP.logic: The sack and heavy rounds commit the axe's penetrating swing. Through the opening, the hand-pushed screwdriver jams the moving part; the axe's stuck blade anchors the obstruction, with all fertilizer still unlit.

combo_id: d:.22 pistol|dmg:.22 rounds|u:jug of motor oil|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Small Bore Routine
SHALLOW.description: The little target pistol enjoys the rare luxury of finding the correct ammunition in its own bag.
SHALLOW.logic: The matching .22 rounds feed the small target pistol for an ordinary modest shot.

MEDIUM.name: Greased Paper Target
MEDIUM.description: A small hole marks the customer while a dark film makes their next step considerably less certain.
MEDIUM.logic: The pistol's matched shot hurts while motor oil coating the recipient leaves a slick, movement-dragging film.

DEEP.name: Quiet Entrance Noisy Exit
DEEP.description: The little shot barely announces itself, but the retreat through oily brass tells the entire street where you went.
DEEP.logic: The quiet matched shot starts the retreat onto oil and spilled .22 rounds. Oil slows the recipient's footing, while the brass gravel's loud movement advertises their location instead of the quiet shooter's.

SHALLOW.name: Farm Freight
SHALLOW.description: The sack carries enough ballast to make the shipping department regret its casual handling policy.
SHALLOW.logic: The heavy fertilizer sack and dense ammunition box hurt on landing; neither has an ignition or matching firearm here.

MEDIUM.name: Dinner Bell Misfiled
MEDIUM.description: The landed bundle screams for visitors and briefly ruins the hearing of those already standing nearby.
MEDIUM.logic: The airhorn's sustained blast attracts attention to the landing and makes nearby ears ring, using the sack and brass box as ballast.

DEEP.name: The Traveling Loudmouth
DEEP.description: The motor announces the courier, the teeth meet a listener, and the fallen parcel keeps calling for an audience.
DEEP.logic: The running saw exposes the thrower before its teeth bite and pull deeper at delivery. When its recipient falls, brass ballast wedges the horn button down, transferring the lasting racket to that fallen spot.

SHALLOW.name: Scorched but Present
SHALLOW.description: The old coat has seen worse days and still knows how to keep the worst of one outside.
SHALLOW.logic: The turnout coat's heavy canvas and heat resistance protect the wearer during ordinary use.

MEDIUM.name: Hands Off the Canvas
MEDIUM.description: The coat softens the greeting while its outward paddles make the visitor regret following through.
MEDIUM.logic: The coat protects the wearer, and a received hit presses the defibrillator paddles into the attacker, releasing a muscle-clenching reactive jolt.

DEEP.name: A Little Breathing Room
DEEP.description: The rising whine invites a bad decision; the visitor freezes mid-greeting while the padded wearer gets shoved out of reach.
DEEP.logic: The charging whine advertises the padded wearer. When struck, the coat turns the glancing blow into a shove on the user while the full paddle discharge locks the attacker, opening separation.

combo_id: d:box of nails|dmg:chainsaw|u:.22 pistol|m:jar of thermite

SHALLOW.name: Hardware Complaint
SHALLOW.description: A box of loose nails makes one particularly unpleasant patch of floor.
SHALLOW.logic: The nails scatter into small punctures; the chainsaw and pistol contribute no coordinated action, and the thermite stays unlit.

MEDIUM.name: Please Stand Clear
MEDIUM.description: The box starts growling, and anyone investigating gets a faceful of hardware.
MEDIUM.logic: Chainsaw noise attracts attention to the box; its moving teeth fling the loose nails rather than aiming them.

DEEP.name: The Small Print
DEEP.description: A quiet little warning precedes a saw that treats every visitor as more material.
DEEP.logic: The light pistol starts the encounter; the chain pulls into its cut, scattering nails with its bite. Hard-to-light thermite remains useless ballast.

combo_id: d:garden hose|dmg:.22 pistol|u:-|m:block of dry ice

SHALLOW.name: Damp Squib
SHALLOW.description: The pistol rides along while the hose makes everyone's shoes regrettable.
SHALLOW.logic: The hose wets the floor into mud; neither the pistol nor dry ice needs to cooperate for that.

MEDIUM.name: Cold Call
MEDIUM.description: A small pistol report disappears behind a spray that bites bare skin.
MEDIUM.logic: The pistol supplies the small puncture, while dry ice lends its contact cold to the hose's spray.

DEEP.name: Ankle Weather
DEEP.description: One hard spurt sweeps the feet; the corridor keeps the cold after the noise leaves.
DEEP.logic: Releasing the kink gives a shove; water accelerates the dry ice's ground fog, leaving cold and mud where the quiet pistol draws little attention.

combo_id: d:bucket of wet cement|dmg:9mm rounds|u:-|m:power drill

SHALLOW.name: Unscheduled Sidewalk
SHALLOW.description: A thrown bucket deposits an ambitious amount of sidewalk on somebody's boots.
SHALLOW.logic: Wet cement clings and drags; the ammunition stays inert and the drill contributes only weight.

MEDIUM.name: Leasehold
MEDIUM.description: The spill borrows your feet, then quietly converts the loan into ownership.
MEDIUM.logic: Cement first burdens boots and later sets hard; loose inert rounds become aggregate rather than bullets.

DEEP.name: Permanent Installation
DEEP.description: The bucket lands spinning, bites into place, and promotes its occupant to municipal furniture.
DEEP.logic: The drill bites beneath the cement and binds, wrenching the target; rounds jam moving gaps before curing cement makes the hold permanent.

SHALLOW.name: Brass Section
SHALLOW.description: Two boxes of ammunition sit through a concert without firing a single note.
SHALLOW.logic: The boombox draws listeners; both ammunition boxes are inert without their matching firearms.

MEDIUM.name: Wet Encore
MEDIUM.description: Come for the music, stay because the wash is pushing you backward.
MEDIUM.logic: The boombox attracts visitors and the washer pushes them away; dense rifle ammunition keeps the setup planted.

DEEP.name: House Full
DEEP.description: The music fills the doorway; the brass makes leaving a mechanical disagreement.
DEEP.logic: Music brings targets near the washer, whose intake throws loose 9mm rounds into moving gaps; the dense rifle box counterweights the jet.

combo_id: d:bag of marbles|dmg:-|u:tub of pool chlorine|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Wrong Foot
SHALLOW.description: The marbles have excellent range and absolutely no interest in fair footing.
SHALLOW.logic: Glass marbles rolling underfoot interrupt a step; the chlorine remains in its tub.

MEDIUM.name: Pool Rules
MEDIUM.description: Watch your step, mind your eyes, and please stop asking where the pool is.
MEDIUM.logic: Rolling marbles upset balance while chlorine dust stings eyes, making recovery slower without inventing an explosive reaction.

DEEP.name: The Long Walk
DEEP.description: Each sliding foot stirs more white dust; getting upright does not end the visit.
DEEP.logic: Marbles keep feet moving through irritating chlorine dust; the granules' slow attack on skin outlasts the initial stumble.

SHALLOW.name: Oversized Handle
SHALLOW.description: Somebody attached an entire fan to a perfectly adequate piece of steel.
SHALLOW.logic: The crowbar still swings as a heavy bar; the fan makes it unwieldy rather than magical.

MEDIUM.name: Open A Window
MEDIUM.description: The swing delivers steel, followed by a breeze nobody wants to breathe.
MEDIUM.logic: The crowbar delivers the blow while the fan carries the cleaner's eye-stinging fumes along its airflow.

DEEP.name: Gap Year
DEEP.description: A claw opens the seam, a gust opens the distance, and the fumes take residence.
DEEP.logic: The crowbar pries a gap for ammonia mist; the fan drives it inside and pushes the victim back, leaving slick cleaner after the gust ends.

SHALLOW.name: Personal Wall
SHALLOW.description: A clear wall with a handle and a horn nobody has found yet.
SHALLOW.logic: The riot shield turns incoming blows; the unpressed airhorn contributes nothing.

MEDIUM.name: Excuse You
MEDIUM.description: The shield takes the blow and delivers a very loud objection.
MEDIUM.logic: The shield absorbs contact; an airhorn blast makes the attacker flinch with ringing ears.

DEEP.name: Center Of Attention
DEEP.description: Every head turns toward the clear wall, which has already begun moving forward.
DEEP.logic: The horn makes the wielder conspicuous; the shield turns the invited attack into a protected forward push, with a final ear-ringing blast.

SHALLOW.name: Yard Work
SHALLOW.description: The crowbar gets wet while the hose creates a modest local inconvenience.
SHALLOW.logic: The hose soaks the floor into mud; neither the crowbar nor coat changes the spray yet.

MEDIUM.name: Curbside Courtesy
MEDIUM.description: A hooked nozzle noses into a gap and politely insists on more room.
MEDIUM.logic: The crowbar claw wedges the hose into a seam; releasing a kink delivers a concentrated shove through that opening.

DEEP.name: All Weather Friend
DEEP.description: Canvas takes the return blow while the hooked hose makes retreat a muddy proposition.
DEEP.logic: The coat cushions the operator, the crowbar holds the nozzle against resistance, and the hard spurt leaves mud behind its initial shove.

SHALLOW.name: Pocket Change
SHALLOW.description: The ammunition rattles uselessly while the crowbar does the ordinary hard work.
SHALLOW.logic: The crowbar hits with steel; the .357 rounds cannot fire without a matching revolver.

MEDIUM.name: Brass Knucklesworth
MEDIUM.description: Heavy little cartridges give the crowbar a distinctly less negotiable business end.
MEDIUM.logic: The rounds' compact weight loads the swinging bar, adding a balance-breaking jolt to its impact.

DEEP.name: Severance Package
DEEP.description: The claw asks for a small opening, then the brass insists on a much larger one.
DEEP.logic: The claw catches a seam instead of striking flat; dense rounds weight the lever, turning the catch into a wrenching heave.

SHALLOW.name: Cold Seat
SHALLOW.description: An icy block waits on the floor with a bat doing very little nearby.
SHALLOW.logic: Dry ice hurts bare skin through contact cold; the resting bat supplies no automatic swing.

MEDIUM.name: Winter League
MEDIUM.description: The bat gives the icy block a sporting chance at somebody's ankles.
MEDIUM.logic: The bat's sweet spot sends hard dry ice outward, combining its springy impact with the block's contact cold.

DEEP.name: Groundskeeper's Holiday
DEEP.description: The first visitor gets the line drive; everyone after inherits the ankle-high winter.
DEEP.logic: The bat's rebound scatters the hard block into cold contact hazards; the remaining dry ice keeps sublimating into ground-hugging fog after impact.

SHALLOW.name: Brush Business
SHALLOW.description: A long blade handles the brush while the medical supplies await actual customers.
SHALLOW.logic: The machete's ordinary cutting arc works without either medical item.

MEDIUM.name: Walking Appointment
MEDIUM.description: A quick patch and an impatient jab get the blade moving again.
MEDIUM.logic: The kit closes the user's wounds while adrenaline speeds the light machete's repeated swings.

DEEP.name: Pay It Forward
DEEP.description: The blade keeps appointments faster than the body can file its complaints.
DEEP.logic: Adrenaline accelerates the machete's broad cuts; the kit patches the user during work, but the shot's deferred pain still arrives when it ends.

SHALLOW.name: Bad Bedside Manner
SHALLOW.description: Two paddles meet a patient who would very much prefer a second opinion.
SHALLOW.logic: The defibrillator's sudden discharge clenches muscles; the hammer remains dead weight.

MEDIUM.name: Steel Consultation
MEDIUM.description: The hammer offers the paddles a much longer and less comfortable handshake.
MEDIUM.logic: The steel sledgehammer conducts the paddle discharge while its heavy head delivers a physical impact.

DEEP.logic: The dense rounds crack the cleaner jug on landing. Its slick liquid steals footing first; the fumes linger after the spill's initial disruption and drive occupants away.

SHALLOW.name: Bad Delivery Service
SHALLOW.description: The medical supplies arrive strapped to the heaviest possible paperweight.
SHALLOW.logic: The thrown battery hits by dead weight; its attached medical kit does not soften that impact.

MEDIUM.name: Charge To Insurance
MEDIUM.description: The battery handles the argument while the kit handles your previous mistakes.
MEDIUM.logic: The battery's contact arc staggers the recipient; the modifier's gauze and stims restore the user while the parcel travels.

DEEP.name: Deductible Met
DEEP.description: The battery opens its acid account, and your field treatment settles after the fight.
DEEP.logic: A hard landing cracks the battery case and spills corrosive acid. The user treats earlier wounds with the attached kit, receiving its delayed recovery when the encounter ends.

combo_id: d:glass bottle|dmg:can of expanding foam|u:-|m:pressure washer

SHALLOW.name: Empty Promise
SHALLOW.description: The bottle breaks before the elaborate plumbing achieves anything worth mentioning.
SHALLOW.logic: Glass shatters into sharp fragments on impact; the foam and washer fail to cooperate.

MEDIUM.name: Bubble Trouble
MEDIUM.description: The washer throws sticky filler out of the broken bottle and into everybody's afternoon.
MEDIUM.logic: The washer accelerates the bottle's foam contents, pushing the recipient backward while the expanding sticky bead drags their movement.

DEEP.name: New Tenant
DEEP.description: The bottle opens a room, the jet furnishes it, and the foam changes the locks.
DEEP.logic: The broken bottle splashes foam across the target; washer pressure drives it into gaps. The swelling coating initially drags, then cures hard enough to lock those gaps shut.

SHALLOW.name: Clear Boundaries
SHALLOW.description: The trap and blade rattle uselessly behind a perfectly adequate plastic wall.
SHALLOW.logic: The shield turns incoming blows; the attached trap and machete contribute no extra behavior.

MEDIUM.name: Handshake Policy
MEDIUM.description: Anything reaching past the clear panel gets a much firmer greeting.
MEDIUM.logic: The bear trap's steel jaws catch a blocked attacker while the machete's exposed edge cuts the contacting limb.

DEEP.name: Please Form A Queue
DEEP.description: The clear wall ushers you forward, then the reception desk bites shut.
DEEP.logic: The shield's shove herds an attacker toward the trap at its rim. Their answering blow closes the jaws, holding them along the machete's cutting arc.

SHALLOW.name: Demo Tape
SHALLOW.description: The music plays beside a box that absolutely cannot shoot itself.
SHALLOW.logic: The boombox attracts listeners by sound; the unmatched rifle rounds remain inert ballast.

MEDIUM.name: Brass Section
MEDIUM.description: Dense brass keeps the speaker planted while the chorus gets obnoxiously loud.
MEDIUM.logic: The rounds ballast the boombox against jostling, sustaining its attraction; the close-range wall of sound disrupts listeners.

DEEP.name: Encore In Brass
DEEP.description: The audience gathers beneath a bass-rattled box with a very heavy finale.
DEEP.logic: Music lures a listener beneath the ammunition box balanced on the speaker. Sustained vibration walks the dense brass ballast off its perch; the rounds never discharge.

SHALLOW.name: Office Compliance
SHALLOW.description: A brief white puff fulfills the letter of the safety inspection.
SHALLOW.logic: The extinguisher's pressurized cone pushes light targets back; the coat and revolver stay unused.

MEDIUM.name: Cold Shift
MEDIUM.description: The coat takes the rough stuff while the bottle whites out the doorway.
MEDIUM.logic: Protective turnout canvas buffers the user, while the extinguisher's freezing discharge coats the target in cold.

DEEP.name: Final Inspection
DEEP.description: The inspector wears canvas, sprays winter, and sends the empty bottle in last.
DEEP.logic: The coat protects the operator during the freezing spray. When the spray ends, the revolver punctures the still-pressurized bottle, turning it into the stated rocket that shoves forward.

combo_id: d:jug of motor oil|dmg:pressure washer|u:bucket of wet cement|m:garden hose

SHALLOW.name: Bay Three
SHALLOW.description: The oil lands on the floor instead of anywhere useful inside an engine.
SHALLOW.logic: Spilled motor oil denies traction; the washer, hose, and cement remain disconnected baggage.

MEDIUM.name: Express Detailing
MEDIUM.description: The washer removes your finish while the oily floor removes your schedule.
MEDIUM.logic: Hose-fed washer pressure cuts the target on landing; the motor-oil splash slows any attempt to get away.

DEEP.name: Reserved Parking
DEEP.description: The jet chooses your parking space, and the cement makes the reservation permanent.
DEEP.logic: A released hose kink feeds the washer a hard pulse, pushing targets across the oil into clinging cement. After its wet interval, the cement cures around their feet.

SHALLOW.name: Borrowed Uniform
SHALLOW.description: A crowbar hangs uselessly inside a coat that already knows its job.
SHALLOW.logic: The turnout coat's heavy protective canvas buffers the wearer; the crowbar is unused weight.

MEDIUM.name: Rigid Dress Code
MEDIUM.description: A steel bar stiffens the sleeve and gives rude visitors their shove back.
MEDIUM.logic: Canvas absorbs the glancing hit while a crowbar braced inside the sleeve turns the wearer's weight into a retaliatory shove.

DEEP.name: Exit Interview
DEEP.description: Hitting the coat seats the claw; pulling away becomes the worst part.
DEEP.logic: Protective canvas lets the wearer receive a blow against the crowbar's claw. The hooked bar finds an armor seam, then body-weight leverage pries the attacker away.

SHALLOW.name: Bedside Jar
SHALLOW.description: The first attempt at remote medicine delivers mostly broken glass.
SHALLOW.logic: The bottle shatters into cutting shards; the kit and block do not cooperate yet.

MEDIUM.name: Stay For Observation
MEDIUM.description: The bottle delivers treatment while the block ensures the patient stays put.
MEDIUM.logic: The bottle distributes the kit's stims to its recipient; the cinder block pins that recipient during treatment.

DEEP.name: Discharged Eventually
DEEP.description: Your concrete hospital bed opens with treatment and closes with a lively discharge.
DEEP.logic: The block anchors the kit's splint while the bottle releases stims over the patient. When immobilization ends, the movement-enabling treatment sends the recovered recipient onward.

SHALLOW.name: Aggressive Housekeeping
SHALLOW.description: The rifle gets thrown away with the cleaner, which still stings eyes.
SHALLOW.logic: Ammonia fumes interrupt vision on landing; the unfired rifle merely weighs the jug down.

MEDIUM.name: Full Auto Fresh
MEDIUM.description: A short burst arrives before a decidedly industrial splash of cleaner.
MEDIUM.logic: The rifle fires on release, and the thrown jug follows with an eye-stinging ammonia splash.

DEEP.name: Vacancy Notice
DEEP.description: The floor turns treacherous; the room turns hostile; the doorway receives a burst.
DEEP.logic: Cleaner first slicks the landing zone. Its lingering fumes herd occupants outward, where the rifle's delayed full-auto burst meets their forced retreat.

SHALLOW.name: Dead Weight Express
SHALLOW.description: An accurate rifle makes a poor accessory for an inaccurately thrown battery.
SHALLOW.logic: The battery's heavy case supplies blunt impact; the hunting rifle remains unfired.

MEDIUM.name: One For The Road
MEDIUM.description: The rifle sends a deliberate greeting before the terminals arrive personally.
MEDIUM.logic: The hunting rifle fires on release; the charged battery follows with a contact arc that interrupts the target.

DEEP.name: Precision Breakdown
DEEP.description: The battery arrives intact until one careful shot opens the wrong compartment.
DEEP.logic: The rifle's accuracy cracks the thrown battery case at its destination. Acid spills against the victim, and the exposed charged terminals discharge across the remaining gap.

SHALLOW.name: Barefoot Mistake
SHALLOW.description: The smoking block waits patiently for someone to touch it directly.
SHALLOW.logic: Dry ice burns bare skin with cold; the unhelpful blower stays off.

MEDIUM.name: Ground Weather
MEDIUM.description: A low white bank arrives with enough wind to rearrange your stance.
MEDIUM.logic: The blower pushes dry-ice fog downrange; the hard wind shoves while the carried cold slows movement.

DEEP.name: Winter At Ankle Height
DEEP.description: The first gust throws the cold; the last of it refuses to rise.
DEEP.logic: The blower carries loose dry-ice fragments into skin for cold burns. After the gust, their sublimating heavy fog stays low and continues chilling movement.

combo_id: d:nail gun|dmg:roman candle|u:jerrycan of gasoline|m:box of nails

SHALLOW.name: Permit Pending
SHALLOW.description: The fireworks remain decorative while one ordinary framing nail does the work.
SHALLOW.logic: The nail gun fires a sharp framing nail; the gasoline and candle do not cooperate.

MEDIUM.name: Hot Renovation
MEDIUM.description: The nail holds the appointment while a little star keeps glowing against you.
MEDIUM.logic: Framing nails pin the victim in place, and a roman-candle star keeps burning where it lands.

DEEP.name: One Continuous Mistake
DEEP.description: The nail pins a fuel stain; the star gives that stain somewhere else to go.
DEEP.logic: Fuel-coated nails pin and mark the first victim; a burning star ignites the clinging gasoline. When that victim falls, its wide fuel trail carries the same flame onward.

SHALLOW.name: Standard Complaint
SHALLOW.description: The pistol behaves exactly as advertised beside an entirely redundant trumpet.
SHALLOW.logic: The pistol fires its ordinary shot; the airhorn adds no behavior.

MEDIUM.name: Excuse Me Sir
MEDIUM.description: A rude trumpet gets your attention just before the ordinary pistol does.
MEDIUM.logic: The airhorn's ear-ringing blast disrupts the target before the pistol's bullet connects.

DEEP.name: Next Customer Please
DEEP.description: The first customer drops; the trumpet immediately advertises another opening.
DEEP.logic: The pistol does the shooting. After a takedown, the airhorn is left screaming with its button wedged, attracting the next listener to the fallen target's location.

SHALLOW.name: Watering Day
SHALLOW.description: The hose makes mud while the expensive accessories wait for instructions.
SHALLOW.logic: Hose water turns the ground muddy, dragging movement without using the other items.

MEDIUM.name: White Wash Wednesday
MEDIUM.description: The hose delivers a cold cleaning appointment nobody wants on their skin.
MEDIUM.logic: The extinguisher adds freezing discharge to the hose delivery, while bleach damages the skin it splashes.

DEEP.name: After The Rinse
DEEP.description: The cold bleach shower ends with the red bottle leaving its station abruptly.
DEEP.logic: Hose delivery holds bleach against a target chilled by the extinguisher. As the spray ends, a revolver shot punctures the pressure bottle, sending its rocket shove through the same lane.

combo_id: d:bag of gravel|dmg:chainsaw|u:jug of motor oil|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Aggregate Disapproval
SHALLOW.description: The thrown bag delivers a wave of grit and no craftsmanship.
SHALLOW.logic: Loose gravel stings across a broad impact area; the chainsaw remains idle.

MEDIUM.name: Rough Finish
MEDIUM.description: The saw bites while an oily gravel skirt makes retreat undignified.
MEDIUM.logic: Chainsaw teeth cut on landing; scattered gravel and slick motor oil make the victim's footing unsure.

DEEP.name: Get Off My Driveway
DEEP.description: The noise clears the approach; whatever stays meets a saw that pulls itself closer.
DEEP.logic: The running chainsaw's intimidating noise drives targets back before landing. Gravel and oil spoil footing, so its self-feeding teeth can hold the victim in the cut.

combo_id: d:sack of fertilizer|dmg:-|u:crate of overripe produce|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Farm Subsidy
SHALLOW.description: The crop food arrives at speed with no crops in sight.
SHALLOW.logic: A heavy fertilizer sack makes a blunt thrown impact; no ingredient supplies ignition.

MEDIUM.name: Past Its Prime
MEDIUM.description: The sack hits hard, and the fruit makes the landing difficult to leave.
MEDIUM.logic: Fertilizer adds impact weight while burst produce spreads slick, sticky pulp beneath the recipient.

DEEP.name: Compost Office
DEEP.description: The fruit glues the sack to your boots and leaves a mess even after collection.
DEEP.logic: Adhesive produce pulp binds heavy fertilizer pellets around the feet. Breaking that initial hold still leaves the clinging, slick pulp to drag each step; nothing burns.

SHALLOW.name: Last Orders
SHALLOW.description: An empty bottle makes one sharp complaint before retiring in pieces.
SHALLOW.logic: The bottle's first hard landing produces cutting shards; the shotgun remains unused.

MEDIUM.name: Two Drink Minimum
MEDIUM.description: A close shotgun report precedes the bottle's much less professional follow-up.
MEDIUM.logic: The shotgun fires during the throw, then the bottle lands and breaks into sharp fragments.

DEEP.name: Glass Ceiling Fan
DEEP.description: The bottle flies intact until the shotgun turns it into a moving chandelier.
DEEP.logic: The shotgun's report disrupts nearby listeners. Its shot then breaks the airborne bottle at the destination, driving a broad wave of sharp glass beyond the first contact.

SHALLOW.name: Office Breeze
SHALLOW.description: The fan moves loose belongings while the drinks remain optimistically unopened.
SHALLOW.logic: The industrial fan's steady lane pushes whatever light target enters its path.

MEDIUM.name: Neon Crosswalk
MEDIUM.description: Wind spreads a sticky drink trail between a visitor and two very live paddles.
MEDIUM.logic: The fan spreads spilled drinks over the floor; their conductive sticky sheet carries the defibrillator jolt and drags steps.

DEEP.name: Night Shift Dividend
DEEP.description: You drink the fast half, spill the electric half, and pay for both later.
DEEP.logic: Drinking the modifier boosts the operator; the fan spreads the remaining conductive spill for a paddle discharge. When the boost wears off, the drinks' delayed shakes slow the user.

SHALLOW.name: Transparent Intentions
SHALLOW.description: The clear panel works beautifully while its borrowed cutting head stays dark.
SHALLOW.logic: The riot shield turns incoming blows without using the laser cutter.

MEDIUM.name: Reception Window
MEDIUM.description: A protected firing position gives the little industrial light time to work.
MEDIUM.logic: The shield protects the user while its edge braces the cutter for a steady scorching seam.

DEEP.name: Please Lean Closer
DEEP.description: The little red line waits behind the panel for a particularly committed visitor.
DEEP.logic: The braced cutter scorches a line ahead. A blocked attacker pushes into that line; the shield's answering shove draws their contact across the cutter's slow knife.

SHALLOW.name: Minor League Medicine
SHALLOW.description: The bat practices traditional bedside manner by hitting the nearest problem.
SHALLOW.logic: The wooden bat delivers ordinary swing weight; the medical kit remains closed.

MEDIUM.name: Make Some Room
MEDIUM.description: A springy swing clears enough space for a quick and unpleasant stitch.
MEDIUM.logic: The bat's sweet spot sends the recipient backward; that opening lets the user apply the kit's on-the-move wound treatment.

DEEP.name: Doctor On Deck
DEEP.description: A medical clamshell gets a perfect line drive and a surprisingly helpful reception.
DEEP.logic: The bat's sweet spot delivers the hard medical clamshell to a recipient instead of an enemy blow. Its stims close wounds first, then support renewed movement after treatment.

SHALLOW.name: Oily Demo
SHALLOW.description: A black puddle gets a soundtrack nobody remembered to switch on.
SHALLOW.logic: Motor oil removes traction at the jug's landing; the boombox is silent ballast.

MEDIUM.name: Dance Floor Budget
MEDIUM.description: The music invites dancers onto a floor with serious insurance problems.
MEDIUM.logic: The playing boombox attracts listeners directly into the slick motor-oil landing area.

DEEP.name: Follow That Chorus
DEEP.description: The radio skates away, leaving its audience to discover the route underfoot.
DEEP.logic: Oil lets the thrown boombox slide while still attracting listeners. Their pursuit crosses its clinging slick trail, ending in lost balance after the initial invitation.

combo_id: d:salvaged laser cutter|dmg:sack of fertilizer|u:-|m:m16 rifle

SHALLOW.name: Crop Mark
SHALLOW.description: The beam draws a nasty little line without improving any agriculture.
SHALLOW.logic: The laser cutter scorches a seam; the fertilizer and rifle stay unused.

MEDIUM.name: Sowing Discontent
MEDIUM.description: A rifle burst accompanies a red line across a very unhappy sack.
MEDIUM.logic: The rifle contributes ordinary bullet damage while the cutter supplies ignition for fertilizer's fast, mean burn.

DEEP.name: Long Harvest
DEEP.description: The bullets scatter the crop food; the beam follows its row well past quitting time.
DEEP.logic: A rifle burst opens the fertilizer sack downrange. The cutter ignites the scattered pellets, which continue their own burn after the beam stops rather than requiring a new explosive ingredient.

SHALLOW.name: Factory Pencil
SHALLOW.description: A thin line scorches the surface beside two entirely idle accessories.
SHALLOW.logic: The laser cutter's focused light damages the contacted seam without engaging the defibrillator or thermite.

MEDIUM.name: Hold For Signature
MEDIUM.description: The paddles supply stillness while the cutter signs across the same patch.
MEDIUM.logic: The defibrillator clenches muscles, keeping the target still enough for the laser's slow cutting seam.

DEEP.name: Autograph In Steel
DEEP.description: The signature keeps eating through the plate after the pen has left.
DEEP.logic: The paddle jolt holds the target at a thermite-coated seam while focused cutter heat supplies ignition. The persistent thermite burn finishes eating through steel after active cutting ends.

combo_id: d:m16 rifle|dmg:-|u:.30-06 rounds|m:jug of motor oil

SHALLOW.name: Wrong Box Again
SHALLOW.description: The rifle fires its own ammunition and politely ignores the incompatible purchase.
SHALLOW.logic: The M16 fires 5.56 normally; the .30-06 box cannot feed it and contributes no extra shots.

MEDIUM.name: Slippery Service
MEDIUM.description: A regular burst opens an irregular motor-oil problem around the recipient.
MEDIUM.logic: The M16 supplies bullet damage; the oil jug spills a clinging slick at the same destination, without turning mismatched rounds into ammunition.

DEEP.name: Counter Offer
DEEP.description: The wrong rounds balance the oil-heavy rifle while the right ones do their job.
DEEP.logic: The inert brass box counterbalances the oil jug as it tips out a slick ahead. That steadier rifle keeps its ordinary 5.56 burst aligned through the first target.

SHALLOW.name: Red Garden
SHALLOW.description: The red light watches a hose make a perfectly ordinary muddy patch.
SHALLOW.logic: Hose water makes mud underfoot; the flare merely lights the scene.

MEDIUM.name: Night Watering
MEDIUM.description: The hose's hard pulse arrives beneath a red glare that ruins night vision.
MEDIUM.logic: A released hose kink gives a pushing spurt while the flare's bright red light blinds night-adjusted eyes.

DEEP.name: Follow The Red
DEEP.description: The beacon advertises a position whose footing and hospitality both deteriorate quickly.
DEEP.logic: The wet-burning flare marks an inviting visible position despite the spray. A kink-release pulse pushes visitors into the muddy ground already soaked beneath the beacon.

SHALLOW.name: Clear As Brass
SHALLOW.description: An ammunition box weighs down a shield that still stops a glancing blow.
SHALLOW.logic: The shield protects conventionally; unmatched .357 rounds stay inert and the laser stays dark.

MEDIUM.name: Window Service
MEDIUM.description: A little industrial light greets customers; a heavy brass edge handles complaints.
MEDIUM.logic: The cutter scorches on activation; the dense ammunition box weights the shield's answering shove without firing any rounds.

DEEP.name: Etched In Policy
DEEP.description: The brass makes a steady writing desk until a visitor leans into the signature.
DEEP.logic: Inert rounds ballast the shield into a steady cutter brace. Its scorching seam begins first; a blocked attacker then presses along that seam while the panel protects the operator.

SHALLOW.name: Lawn Nurse
SHALLOW.description: The trimmer awkwardly dabs gauze at somebody standing an entire pole away.
SHALLOW.logic: The medical payload supplies wound-closing gauze; the long shaft merely extends its reach.

MEDIUM.name: Personal Space Clinic
MEDIUM.description: A long-distance dressing arrives with a firm reminder to step back.
MEDIUM.logic: The pole delivers the kit's stims to its recipient while its sweeping shaft pushes them out to a safer distance.

DEEP.name: Round The Ward
DEEP.description: The spinning dressing wraps you briefly before sending you back into circulation.
DEEP.logic: Gauze carried around the spinning line winds a dressing onto the recipient, briefly binding movement as it closes wounds. The kit's stims support movement once the wrap is seated.

SHALLOW.name: Parade Leftovers
SHALLOW.description: One burning star clears the tube while the shield enjoys the show.
SHALLOW.logic: A roman-candle star keeps burning where it lands; the shield supplies no extra behavior.

MEDIUM.name: Front Row Tickets
MEDIUM.description: The clear panel shelters the audience of one operating the fireworks.
MEDIUM.logic: The shield protects the operator during firing, while the candle's lobbed stars burn at their landing points.

DEEP.name: The Warm Welcome
DEEP.description: The protective panel makes its own entrance carrying the whole opening act.
DEEP.logic: The shield covers release, then travels forward carrying burning stars caught on its front. Its pushing face delivers both the shove and the stars' persistent contact burn.

SHALLOW.name: Laundry Incident
SHALLOW.description: The jug opens on somebody's clothes and rapidly develops broader ambitions.
SHALLOW.logic: Bleach damages skin it splashes; the unmatched .22 rounds remain inert weight.

MEDIUM.name: Brass Laundry
MEDIUM.description: The bleach strips the finish while loose cartridges ruin the footwork.
MEDIUM.logic: Bleach supplies corrosive contact damage; spilled .22 cartridges act as treacherous brass gravel, never as fired bullets.

DEEP.name: Delicates Cycle
DEEP.description: Leaving the bleach takes careful steps, which gives it all the time it wanted.
DEEP.logic: Brass gravel makes escape from the bleach spill slow and uncertain. That delay lets the skin-ruining liquid continue working after the first splash; no rounds discharge.

SHALLOW.name: Paint Warranty
SHALLOW.description: The water removes the paint and takes an unapproved interest in the surface beneath.
SHALLOW.logic: The washer's cutting jet supplies damage; neither shield nor chainsaw changes the stream.

MEDIUM.name: Covered Patio
MEDIUM.description: The operator gets a clear wall while the recipient gets a hard rinse.
MEDIUM.logic: The riot shield protects the operator; the washer's hard jet pushes the connected target backward.

DEEP.name: Noise Abatement Team
DEEP.description: The saw clears the room into the one lane the washer already owns.
DEEP.logic: The chainsaw's room-emptying roar drives targets toward the washer's lane. The shield braces and protects its operator, letting a steady cutting stream meet that retreat.

SHALLOW.name: Drafty Proposal
SHALLOW.description: A large fan shoves things while the rest resembles an abandoned toolbox.
SHALLOW.logic: The industrial fan's wind pushes light targets; neither crowbar nor inert ammunition is engaged.

MEDIUM.name: Loose Change Weather
MEDIUM.description: The fan spreads brass gravel into a footpath nobody can negotiate gracefully.
MEDIUM.logic: The wind shoves spilled .22 cartridges along the floor, pushing targets onto the same treacherous brass footing.

DEEP.name: Still A Bad Passage
DEEP.description: When the draft finally stops, the floor keeps arguing with your shoes.
DEEP.logic: The crowbar wedges the rolling fan frame steady while its wind pushes visitors across scattered cartridges. When the gust ends, the inert brass remains to make each step uncertain.

combo_id: d:firefighter turnout coat|dmg:-|u:crate of overripe produce|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Stained Uniform
SHALLOW.description: The fruit ruins the laundry budget without improving an already useful coat.
SHALLOW.logic: The turnout coat's heavy canvas protects normally; burst fruit is merely a stain.

MEDIUM.name: Slippery Customer
MEDIUM.description: A punch finds padding first and a very ripe grip problem second.
MEDIUM.logic: The coat buffers incoming contact while slick produce pulp transfers onto the attacker and slows their next movement.

DEEP.name: Fruit Of Your Labor
DEEP.description: The jacket catches a rude hand and keeps the sticky consequences for itself afterward.
DEEP.logic: Canvas withstands the hit while the glue-like half of burst produce catches the attacker's hand. After release, the wearer's own pulp-loaded coat drags their movement.

combo_id: d:bag of marbles|dmg:-|u:crate of overripe produce|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Tiny Bowling Night
SHALLOW.description: Somebody steps onto glass marbles and briefly regrets having legs.
SHALLOW.logic: Marbles roll underfoot and disrupt balance; the produce has not burst yet.

MEDIUM.name: Fruit On The Lanes
MEDIUM.description: The marbles start the skid and the bruised fruit prolongs the indignity.
MEDIUM.logic: Marbles roll through slick produce pulp, causing an initial stumble and leaving a sticky coating that slows recovery.

DEEP.name: Roll Then Stick
DEEP.description: The fruit gives the marbles a getaway and your shoes a much shorter one.
DEEP.logic: Rolling glass spreads the pulp's slippery half beneath a victim, pitching them upward. The same rolling marbles carry its adhesive half onto their feet, catching the landing.

combo_id: d:case of energy drinks|dmg:-|u:-|m:block of dry ice

SHALLOW.name: Wrong Cooler
SHALLOW.description: You grab the smoking block and forget why you wanted a drink.
SHALLOW.logic: Dry ice burns the user's bare skin with cold; the unopened energy drinks provide no benefit.

MEDIUM.name: Sticky Commute
MEDIUM.description: The drink hurries your hands while the spilled remainder argues with your boots.
MEDIUM.logic: Drinking the energy cans accelerates the user, but sticky drink spilled while handling the ice drags their steps.

DEEP.name: Cold Credit
DEEP.description: The fast hands get an icy bill now and a shaking one later.
DEEP.logic: The drinks speed the user while gripping their dry-ice cooler burns bare hands. When the rush expires, the drinks' stated delayed shakes interrupt the same user again.

SHALLOW.name: Carpenter's Lunch
SHALLOW.description: The nail arrives normally, though the surrounding lunch situation has deteriorated.
SHALLOW.logic: The nail gun's framing nail punctures on contact; the steaks are unused cargo.

MEDIUM.name: Meat Appointment
MEDIUM.description: A greasy nail pins dinner in place for whoever can smell it.
MEDIUM.logic: The nail pins its recipient while the carried steak coating advertises that location to hungry creatures.

DEEP.name: Reserved For Dinner
DEEP.description: The smell sets the table; the nail handles seating; the fat discourages leaving.
DEEP.logic: A steak trail draws hungry visitors into the nail's line. The nail pins them at the feeding spot, where slick raw fat makes their eventual escape sluggish.

SHALLOW.name: Routine Checkup
SHALLOW.description: The paddles clench the patient while glass marbles roll away unattended.
SHALLOW.logic: The defibrillator's contact discharge clenches muscles; the cutter and marbles are not engaged.

MEDIUM.name: Unsteady Appointment
MEDIUM.description: The floor ruins the patient's balance just as the little light crosses them.
MEDIUM.logic: Loose marbles interrupt footing, giving the laser cutter time to draw a damaging seam at paddle range.

DEEP.name: No Sudden Movements
DEEP.description: The marbles ask for quick corrections; the paddles firmly decline them.
DEEP.logic: Marbles spill ahead of the thrust, demanding constant balance corrections. The paddle jolt locks the victim's correcting muscles, holding them across the cutter's slow, scorching seam.

SHALLOW.name: Front Desk Canvas
SHALLOW.description: The clear wall does its usual job beside some unopened medical paperwork.
SHALLOW.logic: The shield turns incoming blows; the cutter and first-aid kit are inactive attachments.

MEDIUM.name: Triage Window
MEDIUM.description: Incoming trouble stays outside while a quick dressing goes on behind the panel.
MEDIUM.logic: A successful shield block protects the user long enough for the modifier's gauze and stims to treat earlier wounds.

DEEP.name: One Patient At A Time
DEEP.description: The cutter opens the conversation, the panel ends it, and the kit handles the paperwork.
DEEP.logic: The shield braces the cutter for a damaging seam and shoves back anyone interrupting it. A takedown provides the opening to use the medical modifier on the operator.

SHALLOW.name: Wet Rehearsal
SHALLOW.description: The hose soaks the ground beneath a very overequipped little red beacon.
SHALLOW.logic: Water makes muddy footing; the cables have no live source and cannot electrify it.

MEDIUM.name: Red Glass District
MEDIUM.description: A brilliant red glare makes the incoming bottle fragments harder to avoid.
MEDIUM.logic: The flare blinds night-adjusted eyes while the bottle supplies sharp shards to the spray's contact point.

DEEP.name: Clamp And Circumstance
DEEP.description: The red glare opens the show before a water-filled bottle becomes the curtain call.
DEEP.logic: The flare disrupts vision before release. Cable clamps hold the filled bottle at the hose tip; a released kink breaks it into a shard spray riding the hard water pulse.

combo_id: d:tin of ball bearings|dmg:jerrycan of gasoline|u:box of nails|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Steel Confetti
SHALLOW.description: The tin opens into a shower that nobody mistakes for a celebration.
SHALLOW.logic: Dense steel bearings hit like small thrown weights; gasoline has no stated ignition source.

MEDIUM.name: Hardware Raincheck
MEDIUM.description: The nails handle the punctures while the bearings rearrange the standing arrangements.
MEDIUM.logic: Scattered nails make small wounds, and rolling steel bearings take feet out from under the recipient.

DEEP.name: Please Mind The Floor
DEEP.description: The splash spreads the hardware, and the first stumble introduces the second problem.
DEEP.logic: The wide gasoline splash carries loose hardware across the landing patch without igniting. Bearings start the fall; the victim then meets the nails scattered into the same patch.

SHALLOW.name: Patio Parcel
SHALLOW.description: A steel tank lands heavily without offering the barbecue anyone expected.

DEEP.logic: The cannon boosts a throw weighted by inert rounds. The jerrycan then splashes persistent gasoline over the landing, weighing down soaked clothing and hindering movement without ignition.

combo_id: d:dewar of liquid nitrogen|dmg:jar of thermite|u:pump shotgun|m:jug of motor oil

MEDIUM.logic: Nitrogen freezes on contact, while motor oil coats the landing in a persistent film with poor traction; neither property requires lighting the thermite.

DEEP.name: Brittle Negotiations

MEDIUM.description: The blade looks freshly cleaned, which is little comfort when the cleaning fluid follows it into a cut.
MEDIUM.logic: The machete transfers anything smeared on its blade into cuts. Bleach on that blade therefore keeps irritating the wound after the initial slice.

DEEP.name: Attention Housekeeping
DEEP.description: The horn announces a cleaning emergency; the broad blade delivers an extremely personal inspection.
DEEP.logic: A wedged airhorn attracts listeners before the swing. Its deafening blast jars them while the machete carries skin-ruining bleach into each cut.

SHALLOW.name: Unlit Occasion

MEDIUM.name: Garden In January

DEEP.name: The Wrong Season

DEEP.logic: The hose distributes a wet coating that nitrogen freezes brittle. The following jerrycan impact shatters that stiffened surface; gasoline stays unlit throughout.

SHALLOW.logic: The turning steaks' far-carrying smell attracts hungry creatures to the placed cooler.

MEDIUM.name: Grease Reservation

MEDIUM.logic: The meat's odor brings hungry targets to the cooler, while its soap-slick fat makes their footing uncertain.

DEEP.name: Table For Trouble
DEEP.description: Rattling brass advertises trouble, sour meat advertises supper, and the little pistol waits beside the slippery welcome mat.

MEDIUM.name: Red Pencil Revision

MEDIUM.logic: The laser cutter scorches a seam at the rifle's point of aim, adding sustained heat to the rifle's immediate bullet impact.

DEEP.name: Signed In Daylight

DEEP.logic: The flare's fierce brightness staggers night eyes. The cutter weakens a narrow seam with heat, letting the rifle's subsequent shots pass through the scored material.

SHALLOW.logic: Roman-candle stars keep burning after they land, leaving a modest sustained burn.

DEEP.logic: Adrenaline accelerates shield and shotgun handling while postponing pain. The shield protects through a countershot; the injector's delayed pain then charges the user when its hurry ends.
