DEEP.logic: Oil forces the visitor into a slow braced stance against the airflow. Once that stance fails, the still-running fan carries them backward and the clinging slick ruins their landing.

SHALLOW.name: Basic Pressure Sales
SHALLOW.description: The jet makes a firm argument for moving a few steps backward.
SHALLOW.logic: The washer's concentrated stream pushes the target away.

MEDIUM.name: Cartridge Rinse Cycle
MEDIUM.description: The jet scours the surface and leaves a stubborn piece of brass in the works.
MEDIUM.logic: The cutting water jet hurts while an inert round carried through it wedges a moving joint.

DEEP.name: No Spin Cycle
DEEP.description: The brass stops the joint while the water continues trying to send the rest of you elsewhere.
DEEP.logic: An inert cartridge jams the target's joint against the washer's opposing push. The held seam stays under the paint-stripping stream until sustained pressure cuts into it.

SHALLOW.name: Committed Introduction
SHALLOW.description: The axe head introduces itself with very little interest in a second conversation.
SHALLOW.logic: The heavy axe head cuts through the momentum of its committed swing.

MEDIUM.name: Live Edge Etiquette
MEDIUM.description: The blade makes contact and a crackling arc makes the recipient reconsider moving.
MEDIUM.logic: The axe cuts while its metal head carries the taser's muscle-locking current into contact.

DEEP.name: Permission to Leave Denied
DEEP.description: The blade finally comes loose, but your muscles have not received the same permission.
DEEP.logic: The axe's deep bite sticks and physically holds the recipient. Taser current travels through the lodged metal, leaving a final muscle-clenching interruption as the blade is withdrawn.

combo_id: d:jug of ammonia cleaner|dmg:crate of overripe produce|u:fire extinguisher|m:-

SHALLOW.name: Unripe Cleaning Policy
SHALLOW.description: The smell reaches your eyes before anyone gets around to discussing the fruit.
SHALLOW.logic: Ammonia fumes sting the recipient's eyes shut at the splash point.

MEDIUM.name: Fruit Aisle Weather
MEDIUM.description: A white gust relocates the shopper through a very unfortunate patch of pulp.
MEDIUM.logic: The extinguisher shoves the target through burst produce, whose slick, sticky pulp clings and slows them.

DEEP.name: Takeaway Fruit Complaint
DEEP.description: The gust sends you home wearing the produce, and the cleaner refuses to stay at the shop.
DEEP.logic: The extinguisher drives the target through ammonia-wet produce pulp, coating them in its sticky drag. That retained coating carries eye-stinging cleaner fumes along after the original gust ends.

SHALLOW.name: Brass Spectator
SHALLOW.description: The rifle ammunition watches one burning star do all the actual work.
SHALLOW.logic: The candle's star burns at its landing point; the unmatched rifle rounds remain inert.

MEDIUM.name: Steady Little Celebration
MEDIUM.description: A brass brick steadies the show while bright stars make arriving guests blink.
MEDIUM.logic: The dense ammunition box steadies the candle as a counterweight; its stars pop brightly and keep burning where they land.

DEEP.name: Door Open for the Show
DEEP.description: The doorstop keeps the view clear for a performance that becomes less welcoming with every star.
DEEP.logic: The brass box props a doorway open while the first bright, loud star draws and interrupts visitors. Subsequent burning stars follow through that unobstructed opening after the first flash fades.

SHALLOW.name: Trim Expectations
SHALLOW.description: The spinning line offers a modest correction to anyone standing too close.
SHALLOW.logic: The whacker's line stings soft targets throughout its arc.

MEDIUM.name: Frosty Hedge Appointment
MEDIUM.description: A white cone settles the customer before the spinning line gets to work.
MEDIUM.logic: The extinguisher's cold cone freezes the target briefly while the whacker's line shreds at contact.

DEEP.name: Empty Can Full Service
DEEP.description: The white cloud does the polite work before the empty red bottle takes over the sweep.
DEEP.logic: The extinguisher first protects the user by killing nearby flames, then shoves threats to pole length. Once empty, its still-heavy steel body weights the whacker's returning arc into a blunt strike.

SHALLOW.name: Sound Check for Strangers
SHALLOW.description: The room has a soundtrack and would very much like some company.
SHALLOW.logic: The boombox draws listeners toward the placed gadget.

MEDIUM.name: Sticky Front Row
MEDIUM.description: The best listening spot comes with a little white adhesive around the ankles.
MEDIUM.logic: Music gathers visitors onto tacky expanding foam that delays their feet.

DEEP.name: Six Encores Maximum
DEEP.description: The foam fixes the seating arrangement before a six-shooter supplies the closing percussion.
DEEP.logic: The boombox brings visitors into foam that swells around their feet. Once it cures, the fixed target receives the revolver's ordinary shot at the end of the musical invitation.

SHALLOW.name: Gravel Visiting Hours
SHALLOW.description: A heavy bag administers the sort of greeting no bedside manual recommends.
SHALLOW.logic: The thrown gravel supplies a wide wave of stinging grit.

MEDIUM.name: Rough Bedside Manner
MEDIUM.description: The grit introduces the patient while the paddles conduct a brief muscular roll call.
MEDIUM.logic: Gravel hurts on impact, and direct paddle contact discharges a muscle-clenching jolt without treating the stones as conductors.

DEEP.name: Wait for the Whine
DEEP.description: The loose ground delays your exit while the rising note announces a thoroughly unhelpful appointment.
DEEP.logic: Scattered gravel makes the recipient's escape slow and unsure while the defibrillator charges. Its delayed direct-contact discharge then delivers painful current and clenches their muscles together.

combo_id: d:sledgehammer|dmg:-|u:cooler of raw steaks|m:jug of bleach

SHALLOW.name: Heavy Lunch Break
SHALLOW.description: The hammer interrupts lunch with a thoroughly uncomplicated slab of steel.
SHALLOW.logic: The sledgehammer's heavy head supplies a crushing slam.

MEDIUM.name: Slippery Butcher's Bill
MEDIUM.description: The hammer lands where the steak fat has made a quick recovery unlikely.
MEDIUM.logic: The hammer crushes on impact while slick steak fat prevents the recipient regaining easy traction.

DEEP.name: Kitchen Closes with a Bang
DEEP.description: The dinner smell brings guests close enough for the hammer to show them the freshly spoiled floor.
DEEP.logic: Steak scent draws hungry targets toward the user. The hammer's follow-through sends them sliding on fat into spilled bleach, whose skin-stripping contact continues after the slam.

combo_id: d:box of nails|dmg:weed whacker|u:-|m:can of hairspray

SHALLOW.name: Nailbert
SHALLOW.description: A modest pile of hardware has developed strong feelings about passing feet.
SHALLOW.logic: Loose placed nails puncture whoever steps into their sharp points.

MEDIUM.name: Fringe Benefits
MEDIUM.description: The spinning line distributes hardware samples to everyone near the unpaid landscaping job.
MEDIUM.logic: The whacker scatters nails through its arc, causing punctures, while hairspray's sticky mist hinders movement through the patch.

DEEP.name: Salon de Lawn
DEEP.description: The sticky styling treatment keeps the customer within reach for one last unfortunate trim.
DEEP.logic: Hairspray retains loose nails against the recipient and delays their escape. The whacker's continuing sweep catches those retained sharp points again when the sticky coating finally pulls loose.

SHALLOW.name: Fit Check
SHALLOW.description: The shells fit the shotgun, which is the entire success story so far.
SHALLOW.logic: Matching 12-gauge shells let the pump shotgun deliver its ordinary spread; the 9mm rounds remain inert.

MEDIUM.name: Brass Paper Jam
MEDIUM.description: The wide shot leaves the usual marks and one unusually inconvenient piece of brass.
MEDIUM.logic: The matching shell supplies the damaging spread, which drives an inert 9mm cartridge into a target joint as a mechanical wedge.

DEEP.name: Waste Nothing Department
DEEP.description: The wrong cartridge delays your own equipment before finding a more useful place to be wrong.
DEEP.logic: A stray 9mm round jams the pump and delays its user. Clearing that inert wedge frees matching shells to fire, driving the discarded cartridge into the target's joint where the same jamming property now helps.

combo_id: d:case of energy drinks|dmg:jerrycan of gasoline|u:sledgehammer|m:tub of pool chlorine

SHALLOW.name: Early Start Bad Cargo
SHALLOW.description: The cans get you moving before you reconsider anything else on the packing list.
SHALLOW.logic: Energy drinks quicken the carrier while the rest of the load remains unused.

MEDIUM.name: Caffeine Freight Company
MEDIUM.description: The drinks offer express service, but the hammer is traveling at its own rate.
MEDIUM.logic: Caffeine accelerates the user while the sledgehammer's substantial weight slows the loaded carrier.

DEEP.name: Captain Overtime
DEEP.description: The smell announces a hurried arrival, and shaking hands turn the inventory into a personal problem.
DEEP.logic: Caffeine speeds the carrier while gasoline and chlorine smells advertise their position. Delayed shakes destabilize the heavy hammer and spill chlorine onto the wearer, interrupting movement and damaging exposed skin.

SHALLOW.name: Brass for Breakfast
SHALLOW.description: The cans supply all the excitement while the ammunition waits for a rifle that never arrives.
SHALLOW.logic: Energy drinks quicken the user; the unmatched .30-06 rounds remain inert.

MEDIUM.name: Canned Overtime Invoice
MEDIUM.description: The first cans buy a quick trip, and the last few steps collect the interest.
MEDIUM.logic: The drinks' initial haste ends in their stated shakes; the carried brass box supplies no magical ammunition benefit.

DEEP.name: Doorstop Departure Club
DEEP.description: A box of unused ammunition buys a little privacy for a very caffeinated exit.
DEEP.logic: The dense brass box wedges the entrance as a doorstop, protecting the user's withdrawal while the drinks supply haste. Their delayed shakes interrupt the escape once that brief advantage ends.

combo_id: d:dewar of liquid nitrogen|dmg:-|u:-|m:case of energy drinks

SHALLOW.name: Iced Arrival
SHALLOW.description: A white splash provides the recipient with a very abrupt change of plans.
SHALLOW.logic: The nitrogen freezes whatever surface the thrown dewar splashes.

MEDIUM.name: Express Cold Service
MEDIUM.description: The courier drinks warm soda while the customer receives a much less forgiving refreshment.
MEDIUM.logic: The modifier drinks quicken the thrower while the dewar's nitrogen freezes the recipient.

DEEP.name: Two Kinds of Shakes
DEEP.description: The target discovers brittle movement just as the courier discovers the downside of liquid enthusiasm.
DEEP.logic: The drinks hurry the thrower while nitrogen makes the recipient brittle. Their recoveries coincide: renewed movement cracks the chilled surface, while the thrower's delayed caffeine shakes interrupt any follow-up.

SHALLOW.name: Small Tool Big Opinion
SHALLOW.description: A palm-sized point offers exactly as much reach as your arm is willing to provide.
SHALLOW.logic: The screwdriver punctures wherever the user pushes its steel tip.

MEDIUM.name: Padded Maintenance Call
MEDIUM.description: The coat takes the glancing hit while the little tool stops the troublesome joint.
MEDIUM.logic: Protective canvas cushions the user's approach, letting the screwdriver wedge a moving part and stop it.

DEEP.name: Authorized Entry
DEEP.description: The coat permits a close inspection, the jaws keep the appointment, and the steel point finds its way inside.
DEEP.logic: The screwdriver props the trap open until the thrust dislodges it around the recipient. Coat protection lets the user lean their weight into the screwdriver's sheet-metal-punching point while the jaws hold contact.

SHALLOW.name: Empty Bottle Average
SHALLOW.description: The bottle breaks nicely despite a complete absence of sporting ambition.
SHALLOW.logic: The thrown bottle shatters into sharp glass on its first hard impact.

MEDIUM.name: Full Bottle League
MEDIUM.description: A heavy bottle gets the sweet-spot treatment and arrives with very strong opinions about personal space.
MEDIUM.logic: Gasoline fills the bottle with extra weight; the bat's springy sweet spot drives that load into a cutting, forceful impact without igniting it.

DEEP.name: Not Quite Champagne
DEEP.description: The celebratory spray includes broken glass and begins inconveniently close to the batter.
DEEP.logic: The bottle breaks at the bat's first hard contact, nicking its own user. The bat sends sharp fragments forward while the gasoline's broad liquid splash interrupts the recipient; nothing supplies ignition.

SHALLOW.name: Garden Sack Almanac
SHALLOW.description: The gardening calendar predicts one heavy arrival and a short period of regret.
SHALLOW.logic: The fertilizer sack's weight supplies an ordinary blunt impact.

MEDIUM.name: Brush League Delivery
MEDIUM.description: The sack carries a flat blade and receives a very enthusiastic sendoff from the bat.
MEDIUM.logic: The machete slices as the thrown sack lands, and the bat's springy sendoff adds a backward shove to its weight.

DEEP.name: Seeds of the Away Game
DEEP.description: The sack opens early, the bat distributes its contents, and the floor keeps the leftovers in play.
DEEP.logic: The machete opens the sack so the bat can drive small hard pellets into a broad, stance-breaking impact. Loose pellets then remain underfoot, slowing recovery without inventing an ignition source.

SHALLOW.name: Copper Clerk
SHALLOW.description: The clips take hold of their paperwork and refuse to release the customer.
SHALLOW.logic: The jumper clamps bite and hold without any live electrical source.

MEDIUM.name: Dead Current Account
MEDIUM.description: The heavy brass makes a rude introduction while the copper insists on keeping the appointment.
MEDIUM.logic: Inert .357 rounds weight the thrust into a blunt hit, and the cable clamps keep their grip; thermite remains unlit.

DEEP.name: The Collection Department
DEEP.description: The clips secure the customer while a hanging account of brass prepares its final argument.
DEEP.logic: Clamps arrest movement while dense rounds and the unlit thermite jar hang from long leads. Releasing that weighted bundle swings it through the held recipient, striking hard and pulling them off their position.

SHALLOW.name: Red Can Regards
SHALLOW.description: A white cone offers a frosty greeting while the collection of blades waits politely.
SHALLOW.logic: The extinguisher's freezing spray briefly locks the recipient in cold contact.

MEDIUM.name: Pole Position
MEDIUM.description: The white gust places its guest at exactly the wrong end of the garden tool.
MEDIUM.logic: The extinguisher shoves the target into the whacker's full-pole reach, where spinning line shreds across the spray's frontage.

DEEP.name: Courtesy Clearing Crew
DEEP.description: The axe keeps the guest in the white cloud while the lighter tools complete the visit.
DEEP.logic: The axe's sticking bite anchors the target inside the freezing cone. As that hold ends, the whacker's broad reach and machete's quick repeatable arcs sweep the still-occupied position together.

SHALLOW.name: Garden Variety
SHALLOW.description: A sack dangles from a crowbar and makes an already unpleasant swing slightly more agricultural.
SHALLOW.logic: The fertilizer's weight adds heft to the steel crowbar; neither item supplies ignition.

MEDIUM.name: The Root Problem
MEDIUM.description: The claw gets underneath an awkward customer, and the sack gives the other end some authority.
MEDIUM.logic: The crowbar finds a seam; the heavy fertilizer sack weights its lever, lifting and unsettling the caught target.

DEEP.name: Harvest Clause
DEEP.description: First the claw opens a seam. Then the torn sack makes the landing an argument with loose pellets.
DEEP.logic: The claw bypasses plates through seams rather than brute force. The heavy sack splits against the landing surface, spilling pellets that spoil the target's footing.

SHALLOW.name: Grey Expectations
SHALLOW.description: The powder refuses to perform, leaving a fairly disappointing jar full of brass to throw.
SHALLOW.logic: Thermite needs ignition and the rounds need a matching firearm; only the thrown jar's weight connects.

MEDIUM.name: Pocket Scree
MEDIUM.description: The jar breaks, and its ammunition begins a much less glamorous career beneath somebody's shoes.
MEDIUM.logic: The rounds remain inert, but spilled brass is treacherous underfoot. The jar distributes that footing hazard without lighting the powder.

DEEP.name: False Alarm Department
DEEP.description: A suspicious grey spill draws a crowd with brass chatter, then makes every curious foot regret arriving.
DEEP.logic: Spilled rounds are loud enough to attract attention and treacherous enough to trip it. The unlit thermite is an inert carrier, not an invented ignition source.

SHALLOW.name: Window Weight
SHALLOW.description: A clear wall accompanies a concrete block on a very short and unhappy flight.
SHALLOW.logic: The cinder block is devastating when dropped close; the attached shield mostly makes it awkward.

MEDIUM.name: Portable Eviction
MEDIUM.description: The clear panel shoves its occupant backward before the concrete insists they remain there.
MEDIUM.logic: The riot shield's broad pushing face spreads the block's momentum; the block then pins whatever it lands on.

DEEP.name: The Closing Window
DEEP.description: Borrow a wall for the windup, then send it forward to install a concrete footrest nobody requested.
DEEP.logic: The shield protects during the throw's windup and pushes on contact. Its concrete ballast drops onto the displaced target, crushing and pinning them.

combo_id: d:bucket of wet cement|dmg:-|u:tub of pool chlorine|m:9mm pistol

SHALLOW.name: Wet Monday
SHALLOW.description: A bucket empties around somebody's boots while an unnecessary pistol makes the handle even worse.
SHALLOW.logic: Wet cement clings to boots and drags steps; the pistol contributes no shot to this thrown reading.

MEDIUM.name: Poolside Renovation
MEDIUM.description: The splash leaves heavy boots and bleachy grit, a renovation nobody survives with their trousers intact.
MEDIUM.logic: Cement holds the chlorine granules against fabric and skin, extending their stated corrosive contact while weighing down each step.

DEEP.name: Permanent Pool Rules
DEEP.description: The first splash makes escape unpleasant. The second thought comes too late: the floor has finished curing.
DEEP.logic: Chlorine dust stings while cement burdens the feet; when the wet phase expires, curing makes the restraint rigid. The pistol remains discarded ballast, not an unexplained automatic gun.

SHALLOW.name: Care Package Economy
SHALLOW.description: A rattling tin delivers a few bandages with all the bedside manner of a mailbox.
SHALLOW.logic: The first-aid kit is the payload, so its wound-closing supplies benefit the recipient of the thrown tin.

MEDIUM.name: Slip and Stitch
MEDIUM.description: The bandages arrive just before the loose bearings offer their patient an unexpected sitting position.
MEDIUM.logic: The kit closes the recipient's wounds; bearings spilling from its delivery tin take their feet out from underneath them.

DEEP.name: Discharge Instructions
DEEP.description: Splints keep the patient together, stims put them in motion, and the spilled contents challenge that excellent progress.
DEEP.logic: The kit's splints brace the recipient and its stims help them move. The dense bearings become a separate footing hazard when the tin empties.

combo_id: d:first-aid kit|dmg:salvaged laser cutter|u:-|m:jug of ammonia cleaner

SHALLOW.name: Basic Coverage
SHALLOW.description: The sensible part of this arrangement is the little box of gauze you open first.
SHALLOW.logic: The first-aid kit closes the user's wounds; the cutter and ammonia remain unused accessories.

MEDIUM.name: Stitch in Light
MEDIUM.description: A terribly overqualified cutting head opens the dressings, and the dressings immediately justify their own presence.
MEDIUM.logic: The laser's scorching line catches the user while opening the kit; gauze and stims repair more than that careless cut costs.

DEEP.name: Aftercare Waiver
DEEP.description: Splinted, stimulated, and mildly scorched, you leave treatment briskly. The cleaner's trapped fumes get the last appointment.
DEEP.logic: Splints brace the user and stims keep them moving despite the cutter's heat. Ammonia carried with the kit lingers, stinging the user's eyes after the initial benefits expire.

SHALLOW.name: Birthday Defect
SHALLOW.description: The foam misses its cue, leaving one ordinary burning star to carry the entire celebration.
SHALLOW.logic: The roman candle's star keeps burning where it lands; the gap filler contributes nothing yet.

MEDIUM.name: Sticky Occasion
MEDIUM.description: A bright star arrives wearing a tacky collar that makes brushing it off considerably less dignified.
MEDIUM.logic: The candle supplies a burning star, while expanding foam's sticky bead holds the recipient in awkward contact with it.

DEEP.name: The Guestbook
DEEP.description: A glowing invitation lands in a rising loaf of foam. Guests discover their signatures have become footprints in stone.
DEEP.logic: A candle star's light and pop attract attention to sticky expanding foam. The foam delays arrivals until its tacky phase ends and it cures into rigid restraint.

SHALLOW.name: Farmhand Special
SHALLOW.description: A shotgun carries a sack of gardening supplies and remains aggressively uninterested in horticulture.
SHALLOW.logic: The pump shotgun fires normally; the fertilizer is just weight hanging from it.

MEDIUM.name: Broadcast Season
MEDIUM.description: The wide report scatters hard garden pellets across a very small and unwilling field.
MEDIUM.logic: The shotgun's broad spread gives fertilizer pellets a short-ranged impact; their heavy scatter also disrupts the recipient's balance.

DEEP.name: Hazard Harvest
DEEP.description: The garden pellets catch the gun's flash, spread their bad news, and finish with the label's least agricultural promise.
DEEP.logic: The shotgun supplies a firing flash and burning propellant. Fertilizer catches, burns rapidly, and turns that shared burning material into the blast promised by its association cloud.

SHALLOW.name: Unlicensed Birthday
SHALLOW.description: A pistol weighs down a perfectly serviceable firework without improving its sense of occasion.
SHALLOW.logic: The roman candle still lobs a burning star; the pistol is irrelevant to that simple delivery.

MEDIUM.name: Opening Remarks
MEDIUM.description: A sidearm cracks at the start of the performance, followed by a star with terrible seating manners.
MEDIUM.logic: A normal pistol report startles nearby listeners during use; the roman candle remains the lobbed delivery, depositing its lingering burning star.

DEEP.name: Curtain Call Caliber
DEEP.description: The opening report turns heads toward you. A bright popping star moves the audience's attention somewhere much less comfortable.
DEEP.logic: The pistol's ordinary report first advertises the user. The candle's bright, loud star then becomes the distraction at the landing point, where its persistent heat punishes that attention.

SHALLOW.name: Unbalanced Luggage
SHALLOW.description: A sloshing can and its sharp accessories land together with the grace of dropped shopping.
SHALLOW.logic: The thrown jerrycan and machete deliver a crude physical impact; the grinder's motor remains unused.

MEDIUM.name: Orange Peel
MEDIUM.description: The grinder kisses the blade, and the departing can takes a little orange weather along for the ride.
MEDIUM.logic: The grinder throws sparks off the machete's metal, providing the ignition that the gasoline's persistent splash needs.

DEEP.name: The Long Goodbye
DEEP.description: The blade leaves a wet calling card. The sparks arrive next, and the spilled goodbye spreads much farther than the can.
DEEP.logic: The machete transfers smeared gasoline into its cut. Grinder sparks ignite the fumes first, then the soaked liquid continues burning across the connected spill.

SHALLOW.name: Neon Breakfast
SHALLOW.description: Warm caffeine helps you carry a box of ammunition that has nowhere useful to go.
SHALLOW.logic: The energy drinks quicken the user; without a matching revolver, the heavy rounds remain baggage.

MEDIUM.name: Brass Ankles
MEDIUM.description: Your hands are ahead of schedule, but the brass in your pockets has filed a competing itinerary.
MEDIUM.logic: The drinks accelerate the user while the unusually heavy rounds burden their movement, producing haste with a simultaneous weight penalty.

DEEP.name: The Late Invoice
DEEP.description: The cans buy a brief lead over your thoughts. Then the shakes arrive, and every brass-filled pocket starts swinging.
DEEP.logic: Energy drinks provide early haste and later shakes. The heavy rounds turn those shakes into swinging baggage, leaving the user slowed after the initial loss of balance.

SHALLOW.name: Brush Optional
SHALLOW.description: A hunting rifle fires a hunting shot while its attached machete enjoys an uneventful afternoon.
SHALLOW.logic: The rifle's ordinary long-range shot does the work; the machete adds no payload by itself.

MEDIUM.name: Clear Sight Policy
MEDIUM.description: One light sweep opens the brush, and a deliberate shot uses the invitation.
MEDIUM.logic: The machete clears obstructing brush quickly, improving the user's passage into position before the accurate rifle shot lands.

DEEP.name: Patient Footsteps
DEEP.description: Stand still for the difficult part. Once the target falls, the brush blade gets you moving again.
DEEP.logic: The rifle's slow, deliberate use costs mobility while delivering an accurate hit. After a kill, the light brush-clearing machete opens a quick route out of the firing position.

SHALLOW.name: Tin Receptionist
SHALLOW.description: A tossed horn announces its arrival with the bedside subtlety of a loading dock.
SHALLOW.logic: The airhorn's blast draws attention to the place where the tin lands; the bearings stay inside.

MEDIUM.name: Rattle RSVP
MEDIUM.description: The horn invites everybody over, and the tin spills a remarkably unfriendly welcome mat.
MEDIUM.logic: The horn attracts nearby listeners to its landing point, where the scattered steel spheres disrupt their footing.

DEEP.name: Please Hold Forever
DEEP.description: One bearing holds the button while the others roll out to greet callers. The music is terrible; the floor is worse.
DEEP.logic: A dense bearing wedges the horn's button down, sustaining its invitation. The remaining spheres spread underfoot, forcing careful steps and a final stumble as the horn runs dry.

SHALLOW.name: Salon Leftovers
SHALLOW.description: A sticky mist settles over the opposition while two garden tools contribute mostly inconvenience.
SHALLOW.logic: Unlit hairspray hangs in a sticky mist, mildly hindering whoever it coats.

MEDIUM.name: Hot Appointment
MEDIUM.description: The grinder lends the salon a spark, and the mist discovers a much louder profession.
MEDIUM.logic: The grinder's sparks ignite the hairspray's flammable propellant. Sticky mist holds its recipient briefly in the resulting heat.

DEEP.name: Fringe Benefits
DEEP.description: A spinning line combs sticky mist across a broad arc. The grinder supplies the finishing touch nobody asked the stylist for.
DEEP.logic: The weed whacker's broad spinning line spreads hairspray and stings soft targets. Grinder sparks then ignite the lingering mist, extending the contact into a wider burning finish.

combo_id: d:jug of motor oil|dmg:roman candle|u:pressure washer|m:adrenaline shot

SHALLOW.name: Driveway Etiquette
SHALLOW.description: The oil jug lands open and immediately lowers the standard of everyone's footwork.
SHALLOW.logic: Motor oil spreads into a slick film on landing, taking traction away without needing ignition.

MEDIUM.name: Midnight Detailing
MEDIUM.description: A burning star sits in a stubborn oil stain until the stain starts contributing to the problem.
MEDIUM.logic: The roman candle provides sustained ignition for the oil's flammable film; the same oil remains a treacherous surface underfoot.

DEEP.name: Express Valet
DEEP.description: You rush the delivery, the washer spreads the landing, and the stars collect the parking fee. Your legs receive a separate bill.
DEEP.logic: Adrenaline hastens the throw. The washer pushes oil outward at landing, displacing targets into a wider candle-lit film; the injector's deferred pain arrives after the rush.

SHALLOW.name: Red Probe
SHALLOW.description: A flare pokes out between two clamps, doing all the useful work by being very hot.
SHALLOW.logic: The flare supplies contact heat at the cable's thrusting end; no live electrical source is present.

MEDIUM.name: Clingy Visitor
MEDIUM.description: The clamp introduces the flare, then refuses to let either party leave the conversation.
MEDIUM.logic: The cable clamp bites and holds the target, keeping the flare's persistent flame in contact.

DEEP.name: Found You Redhanded
DEEP.description: A bright jab steals a blink, a clamp steals a step, and the red guest stays to illuminate the mistake.
DEEP.logic: The flare's brightness blinds night eyes before the clamp holds. Its windproof flame keeps burning, and the attached light marks the caught target for surrounding attention.

SHALLOW.name: Target Practice Beige
SHALLOW.description: A modest pistol takes a modest shot beside a grinder having a quiet day off.
SHALLOW.logic: The small-bore target pistol fires normally; the grinder is unused weight in this reading.

MEDIUM.name: Warranty Void
MEDIUM.description: The abrasive disc eats too close to your grip, but the little pistol still manages its appointed errand.
MEDIUM.logic: The grinder's abrasive bite becomes a handling cost to the user, while the pistol continues delivering its ordinary shot.

DEEP.name: Tiny Opening Night
DEEP.description: An extravagant fan of sparks makes a tiny pistol impossible to overlook. Looking directly at the performance is also unwise.
DEEP.logic: The grinder's aimed spark stream attracts attention to the user and dazzles nearby eyes. The otherwise quiet pistol places a shot during that brief distraction.

SHALLOW.name: Red Parcel
SHALLOW.description: An axe accompanies the flare, but the red stick makes the first and hottest introduction.
SHALLOW.logic: The thrown flare burns on contact; the axe has not been given a useful role yet.

MEDIUM.name: Doorbell Service
MEDIUM.description: A heavy axe delivers the flare with a knock that takes its own doorway along.
MEDIUM.logic: The axe's committed momentum adds a deep physical bite to the thrown flare's persistent heat.

DEEP.name: Reserved in Red
DEEP.description: The axe sticks where it lands, leaving a bright red reservation that nobody can comfortably occupy or ignore.
DEEP.logic: The axe embeds and holds the flare in place. Its deep bite pins the recipient while the weatherproof flame burns and marks that location for attention.

combo_id: d:jar of thermite|dmg:.30-06 rounds|u:-|m:jerrycan of gasoline

SHALLOW.name: Unlit Ambitions
SHALLOW.description: All the dramatic ingredients arrive, but nobody remembered to invite an actual source of ignition.
SHALLOW.logic: Neither inert rifle rounds nor gasoline lights thermite. The ammunition's dense brass box merely weights the thrown jar.

MEDIUM.name: Brass Door Service
MEDIUM.description: The brass brick bounces off a shin and settles against a foot with doorstop determination.
MEDIUM.logic: The rounds behave as a dense brick and doorstop, striking then wedging a foot; the unlit powder and gasoline remain inert baggage.
